_comment: Playwright MCP config for the browser-verify pass. Viewport is pinned to desktop 1280x720 and the session video records at the SAME size — if they differ, Playwright scales the page into the frame and the result looks like a small/mobile capture. recordVideo flushes the .webm on browser close (verify-prompt step 5). @playwright/mcp 0.0.77 has no --save-video CLI flag — contextOptions is the supported route.
